posts.title: Dino Musics
posts.description: This piece is one of three pieces that was inspired by a trip to a dinosaur-themed roadside attraction that had "dinosaur music".

posts.title: Games and Pomodoro
posts.description: It isn't all about music and graph paper. I like making little games and utilities. Includes Islandoro (a pomodoro timer) and casual games from Danger Academy like Chromadoku and Hexa.

posts.title: Barroom Ballet Sheet Music
posts.description: Thanks to Kaesi Green who made nifty sheet music for Barroom Ballet!
